notes.title: JDM: Japanese Drift Master is now available!
notes.content:
We’ve got great news – our latest title:JDM: Japanese Drift Master, is now live on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/ 
This is a unique game born out of our deep love for cars and passion for Japanese culture.

Get ready to explore the open world of Guntama – a city full of atmospheric streets, mountain passes, and iconic, fully licensed cars. Drift through the corners, tune your vehicles, and follow Touma’s journey through a story-rich manga-style narrative. All of that wrapped in a vibrant soundtrack and a visually engaging world.

If you’re craving fresh thrills and heart-pounding driving that rewards precision – now’s the perfect time to take the wheel!

Still not sure if it’s your thing? Check out the official launch trailer below and see what JDM is all about — we think you’ll feel the rush.

notes.title: Mission Files #1
notes.content:
TOP SECRET  [Major AI behaviour spoilers, use with caution]
                                                                                                                                     January 24, [Spoiler]CLASSIFIED[/spoiler]

Central Intelligence Agency
Antarctic Base of Operation

Attn: Foreign Intelligence Officer
This letter constitutes a report of unidentified specimens observed by [spoiler]Agent "Kurt"[/spoiler] at date [spoiler][CLASSIFIED][/spoiler] have been observed again at [spoiler][CLASSIFIED][/spoiler].

Unidentified specimens earlier reported in [spoiler][CLASSIFIED][/spoiler] has been confirmed as potential biohazard threat. 

Received from local intel data included observations of particularly disturbing facts.

- The unidentified specimens show signs of a self-preservation instinct. Signs of intelligence have not been confirmed. Ongoing Investigation. The specimen does not seem to have set habits, and it's trying to hide from encounters.
Noted behaviours: [spoiler]hiding from sight[/spoiler], [spoiler]photophobia[/spoiler], [spoiler]aggressive if not outnumbered[/spoiler].

- The unidentified specimens show signs of body mutations of unknown origins. Due to the mutation rate, it's hard to determine whether we deal with many specimens or encounter the same repeatedly. 
Noted malformations: [spoiler]Multiple heads[/spoiler], [spoiler]displaced eyes[/spoiler], [spoiler]various numbers of limbs[/spoiler]

A video material is attached as part of the report and registered as
[spoiler]video material no.001/D013[/spoiler] and [spoiler]video material no.002/D013[/spoiler].

Taken further efforts to learn about the scale of the threat. 
[spoiler]Requesting appropriate preparation of backup forces in case of S.H.T.F situation.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Agent "Kurt"[/spoiler] is awaiting further instructions at radio wave: https://discord.gg/uwG5pywvJE

notes.title: Devlog #12 "Block that parasite!"
notes.content:
Hello there. 

Today we want to go through two subjects. 
While we are indoors, the Parasite can attack us using various passages like windows, doors, ventilation, etc.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/66fe5c605147f00564cfb3743c4a321d71228f39.png

We need tools to prevent our overly cuddly, unwelcome guests from coming in, or we will face certain and awful death. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/eb1ea7ec339d3dc97e154feedcc54d6f0a06d82a.png
Our best friends here is our imagination, planning, crafting and barricade system. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/c9b0ae3c8db2826adae2189d727ca72354534d16.png

We will be able to build barricades in certain spots like doors, windows or even ventilation. Be careful not to block out Your way to escape!  Screenshot of how does it look from the developer side is below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/1e412daf6da1b0c645565ee47e72767c3eaa9fcb.png

The second topic is crafting. We have decided that preparing should be clear, easy to read, straightforward but first of all - useful for our survival.

In the crafting menu, there will be two main windows. The first window will have a list of materials, and the other will show all your recipes. Some recipes will be from the beginning of the game others will be obtained by different activities such as side quests for NPCs. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/020318a77a532eaf82d571ba3f8e8b94748e598e.png


That's it for today. Until next time. Or earlier on our Discord Channel (click below)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Devlog #7 Flamethrower
notes.content:
Hello there. 

One of the mainly criticised parts of the old version of Buried in Ice and our Game Trailer was the quality of flame from a flamethrower.

We have decided to remake it entirely. We are wondering if we should fuel the flamethrower part of the game balance and make the player choose between powering up a generator and feeding a flamethrower.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/fa1321ebd932e1187f33985aeb8eebc141ad4588.gif
As You can see, it's hand-crafted. It won't be easy to obtain it in the game and will burn fuel fast. Use it wisely and make sure one You want to lit is certainly a monster.

Flamethrower is our most effective weapon against the creature that waits to hug the player.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/3e227e50566dc378aa84324d40d4a20fc5f1202b.gif
An early version of the new flamethrowing effect. WIP

Meanwhile, we are doing a lot of back-end work. Creature AI is constantly improved and expanded (we briefly introduced it here). We work on game weapons and gunplay. We are continually adding, testing and improving stuff like day&nigt cycle, survival mechanics, equipment etc. 

We will talk about all of these in future Devlogs.

Original idea was to set the game only on one base, but now we are working on a larger map with more buildings and interesting locations.

In the next Devlog (should be two more this month), we will share our graphics and locations work in progress.

If You have questions about the game, please ask us on our Discord Channel. 

Yours Buried in Ice Team
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Devlog #4 Monster AI Work in Progress
notes.content:
Hello there!

This month was a coding adventure!
We are pleased to share with you a game mechanic are currently implementing into our game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/109ff42c3c6d2d7664050eee47b7305d7dce4d68.png
Monster Navigation System
Our team is currently working on a navigation system that will make a monster move both on a floor and the walls! You might remember a similar design from the Alien versus Predator series.

In Buried in Ice, it will be a much more complex mechanic, as Alien versus Predator's Aliens mainly used only the shortest path to Player. And Aliens didn't keep approaching when cut in half.

Imagine being attacked by a monster that can spread (yes - SPREAD) in all directions, jump on walls and keep chasing you... scary indeed! Did You just shot off monster hand? Better watch out if it's not crawling to You anyway.

We hope to bring immersion to another level with those mechanics.

Buried in Ice is a horror game. We need to make the monster position ITself according to the players' movement and attack unpredictably. Right now we are testing this system for floors and walls. 

We consider using ceilings as well but we might encounter some serious game difficulty balance problem with this so it needs further testing from our side. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/c94e29c9664772579936ac8bd1035eb983d171ad.png

Work is still in progress, and we still have few things to be fixed. 
For example, the transition between a floor and a wall is not smooth enough yet, and it needs further improvements. 

We need to connect it with the graphical part of the game as well.

Let's use an example here:
We just shot off the hand of the monster. This hand from now will move independently from the main monster body but will behave like its satellite. It might sneak on the player by crawling on the wall. It might hide and wait for an occasion. If the monster will run from us it will run with it to connect with the main body later. If we will start running from the monster then those separate parts might try to chase us.

Since the system is innovative, we need to find most of the solutions by ourselves. Games that have similar working monster movements don't exactly match what we want to create.

But don't worry, the positioning and the monster's priorities are working fine, and it's really promising at this stage of development.


Stay tuned for more! More game mechanics will be introduced in the future Devlogs. If You have questions about the game feel free to ask us on our Discord Channel 

Yours Buried in Ice Team
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Buried Hardware and new work-stations.
notes.content:
Hello there. 

It has been a while. This Devlog was supposed to appear earlier and have different content. 

We have planned to run Devlogs earlier and with more content, but we have met a few obstacles that are the reason for the delay. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/6363ec8777ca148820ea6526f5709e63d4c63f5b.jpg
As you all know, we were able to gain a publisher. Therefore we have established funds and overall higher budget now. We decided the best usage for it to upgrade our working stations as old ones would have serious trouble handling current game scope and quality. 

We ordered all computers something around mid-February. 

Unfortunately, an accident caused the GPU's total failure. 
To put it bluntly, RTX 3090 went to the trash.

Due to the worldwide GPU shortage, we had to wait over one month for a new GPU for our lead programmer to continue working on visual aspects. 

Thankfully waiting period was not entirely wasted. We have used this time to do some serious scripting work that we will share when connecting it with visuals in the next Devlogs. 

So how all this unfortunate event ended? 

Today we have three new computers. We have swapped RTX 3090  to Radeon 6900xt.

How does that affect game development? 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/f45047defbde39789f8c742842f39839b62c14e4.png

Radeon 6900xt is better than RTX 3090 in UNITY projects but would perform worse in Unreal Engine projects.
 
We are making the game in Unity, so it's a win-win situation for both us and players aside from time-loss. 

In future Devlogs, We will explain some mechanics, how will they work and what that will mean for the Player.
 
That should be it for today. In the next Devlog, there will be more about the game. 
Feel free to chat with us on Discord Server

Until next time.
Buried in Ice Team

notes.title: Devlog #2 Interview summary and FAQ answers
notes.content:
Hello there,
We will start with the answers to the FAQ.
 
q1. Is it based on the movie "Thing"? 
a1. No, it is not. The game is inspired by movies and the book "Who goes there?" by John W. Campbell. 

q2. What engine are you using? 
a2. We are using Unity. 

q3. Is this game out yet? 
a3. When we released the trailer, we were halfway to go. It may sound great, but we were doing it in our spare time, so the quality wasn't great. Now we have a publisher and more time and possibilities, so we must rework almost everything to make Buried in Ice a good game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/66fe5c605147f00564cfb3743c4a321d71228f39.png

Now let's proceed to a summary of the interview we were part of on the NoLifeBoys stream. Some of the questions were answered in the FAQ. 

q1. Which horror movie is your favourite? 
a1. I don't have a single one. My favourites are "Alien", "Aliens", "Alien 3" and "Thing" 1982. 

q2. Why did you choose "Thing" as inspiration? 
a2. Because it's a great movie and there aren't many games with that kind of theme, or at least I don't know them. 

q3. Graphics or story? Which is more important? 
a3. There is no easy answer. Why? Because graphics can greatly improve immersion. Without a good story, immersion will not exist at all, at least for me. 

q4. How long it takes to make a game? 
a4. It highly depends on how much money you have. Basically, more money means more time (not always). More time means less cut content/more implemented ideas. It also means the game can be more polished. 

q5. What player have to do to survive? 
a5. It's pretty cold in Antarctica. You better wear your clothes. What more? Do not hug the enemy. 

q6. How many hours will it take to finish the game? 
a6. I can't answer that. 

That should be it for the summary. In the next Devlog, there will be more about the game. 
Feel free to chat with us on Discord Server
Until next time.
Buried in Ice Team
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619896/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png
